description: A four-engined jet airliner in white with a blue nose and blue cheatline sits on a flat, hazy airfield. Its rear door is open with a boarding staircase below it, and a crowd of men in dark suits and hats stands around three dark sedans at the foot of the stairs. A few figures are visible in the doorway. The lighting is warm and low, the style is painterly, and there is no visible text.
